The Punkva River flows through it. Part of it is the Macocha Abyss, its sinkhole is about 138.7 meters deep and also the deepest of its kind (light hole type) in Central Europe. 
It is a popular tourist attraction for casual visitors to the region, in addition to cavers and advanced technical divers.
